result.title: Online Evidence-Containment Prediction over Text Spans under Distinct Queries
result.summary: Evidence-grounded NLP systems often verify nested text regions sequentially, so verifying one region constrains others. We formalize this as Online Evidence-Containment Prediction (OECP): each candidate is predicted before exact verification and queried at most once. Span containment is exactly a triangular 2D product order, making OECP distinct-query online isotonic regression. With multiple admissible targets, worst-case regret is near-linear, $\widetildeΘ(m_{\mathrm{eff}})$, in the effective scale given by endpoint-rank compression; a single fixed target, as in standard QA, admits an explicit polynomial-time learner with optimal $Θ(\log m_{\mathrm{eff}})$ regret, run on real NQ episodes. On Natural Questions, containment yields a large deductive gain plus a smaller learned gain on unresolved candidates, reproduced across two backbones and DPR hierarchies. Expected Search-space Reduction (ESR) turns these probabilities into decisions, localizing evidence in fewer verifier calls on SciFact, ERASER, and DPR hierarchies; on DPR hierarchies under call budgets it outperforms four recent external selectors and raises fixed-reader F1 over learned and generator-greedy scheduling.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将嵌套文本区域的证据验证形式化为在线证据包含预测（OECP），利用包含关系的三角二维乘积序做不同查询下的在线保序回归并给出遗憾界，再以期望搜索空间缩减把预测概率转成验证调用决策，在 NQ、SciFact、ERASER 与 DPR 层级上减少调用并提升 F1。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据包含约束＋预算内验证调用调度」可能为视觉证据筛选及 LOOK/STOP 的决策与成本建模提供可核查线索，但原文为纯文本任务，迁移到多模态推理仍需核查。
